usage: Used to refer to one’s younger brother
Very common in casual spoken Cantonese

examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 lou2 zung6 duk6 gan2 syu1
examples.meaning: My younger brother is still studying.

examples.jyutping: sai3 lou2 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 hok6
examples.meaning: My younger brother didn’t go to school today.
